primary_evidence: Format header and actual bytes emitted by the reference application in the recorded live OBJ interchange fixture.
format_header: The following MRGB block contains ZBrush Vertex Color (Polypaint) and masking output as 4 hexadecimal values per vertex. The vertex color format is MMRRGGBB with up to 64 entries per MRGB line.

observations.mask_direction: Not established by this unmasked/default-state fixture alone.

rgb_quantization_comparison.method: Interpret RR/GG/BB as unsigned 8-bit channels divided by255, then compare with source inline vertex RGB by vertex order. This analyzes fixture bytes, not an OBrush decoder execution.

relationship_to_other_formats: OBJ #MRGB uses a leading mask byte according to the export header; Draw:MRGB describes material/color painting channels and is a different context.
The GoZ SDK treats mask and polypaint as separate data and does not establish this OBJ byte range.
limitations: No controlled ClearMask/MaskAll/partial-mask OBJ export comparison has been recorded.
UV, material and nontrivial masking interchange remain unverified.
The color decoder validates MM syntax but ignores its mask semantics and initializes imported masks to unmasked; this is an explicitly unsupported field, not full mask interoperability.
